pending: full curriculum matrix: specialized comment and preprocessor motions, replacement case conversion, and \= replacement expressions
dropped: the "% register. It is not a valid adapter register and Vim Wilds has no file name to report.

dropped: counted open above ({count}O). Native Vim leaves the cursor on the last opened line; the adapter interlaces the repeats but leaves it on the first, so the final cursor disagrees. {count}i, {count}a, and {count}o all conform and are exposed.

dropped: tag-object yanks that move the cursor (yit/yat where the object starts before the cursor). Vim places the cursor at the start of the yanked range; the adapter leaves it where it was. Tag activities therefore either operate with the cursor already at the range start or use an operator that changes text.

dropped: around-tag operators on elements spanning whole lines (dat over a multi-line element). Vim removes the emptied lines; the adapter leaves the leading indentation as a residual line. Multi-line tag work uses it/cit/dit, which conform exactly.
